about_short_description.short_description: Celonis provides an execution management system that helps companies in running their business processes.

product.name: Celonis Platform
product.description: A cloud-based execution management platform for analyzing, designing, and operating business processes using process data, AI, automation, and operational context.

product.name: Celonis Process Intelligence Platform
product.description: A process intelligence suite that combines process mining, task mining, AI, and automation to create an operational view of business processes and improve execution.

product.name: Celonis Context Model
product.description: A dynamic operational model that combines end-to-end process data, business knowledge, and intelligence to provide context for enterprise AI decisions and actions.

product.name: Celonis Process Intelligence Graph
product.description: An enriched, system-agnostic digital twin and semantic layer that connects process data, business objects, events, and operational knowledge across enterprise systems.

product.name: Celonis AI Solutions
product.description: AI capabilities and services that provide operational context, identify high-impact use cases, measure AI returns, and integrate AI agents and technologies into business processes.

product.name: Supply Chain Solutions
product.description: Process intelligence and AI capabilities for improving supply chain service levels, inventory, supplier reliability, logistics, and operating costs.
